changeLaterNoPage: Hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻololi i kēia i kēlā me kēia manawa ma ka holoi ʻana i ka ʻikepili o kēia pūnaewele i kāu polokalamu kele pūnaewele.
savedAllow: Mālama ʻia: ua ʻae ʻia ʻo Google Analytics.
savedDeny: Mālama ʻia: pio mau ʻo Google Analytics.
analyticsTitle: E ʻae anei iā Google Analytics?
analyticsBody: Hoʻohana kēia pūnaewele iā ia e helu i nā kipa a me nā ʻaoʻao i heluhelu ʻia. Inā ʻae ʻoe, loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki. Pono nō ke hōʻole: hana like ka pūnaewele.
genericNotice: No {host} mai kēia ʻike. E loaʻa iā {host} kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceNotice_youtube: Pāʻani ʻia kēia wikiō mai YouTube mai. E loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceNotice_vimeo: Pāʻani ʻia kēia wikiō mai Vimeo mai. E loaʻa iā Vimeo kāu helu wahi IP.
serviceNotice_google_maps: No Google Maps mai kēia palapala ʻāina. E loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceNotice_speech: E hoʻouna ana kāu polokalamu kele pūnaewele i kou leo i kāna lawelawe leo (Google, Apple a i ʻole Microsoft) e hoʻololi iā ia i kikokikona.
serviceNotice_github: No GitHub mai kēia ʻike. E loaʻa iā GitHub kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceNotice_webstatus: No webstatus.dev mai kēia kūlana Baseline, he papahana na Google Chrome. E loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP.
serviceNotice_aframe: Pono kēia kiʻi 3D i ka waihona A-Frame mai aframe.io mai. E loaʻa iā aframe.io kāu helu wahi IP.
